subject: FintechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: James Harris <james.harris@fintechcorp.com>, Security Team <security@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FintechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Hi James / Fintech security team,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the thorough conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Recap: discovery call focused on SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA considerations, incident response / breach notification SLAs, and BCP/DR readiness.
- Action items (Redwood):
  1) Share SOC 2 status and a short summary of controls (Type II target / current timeline).
  2) Provide our incident response playbook and breach notification timelines (what we commit to externally).
  3) Provide high-level BCP/DR evidence (DR region, RTO/RPO targets, tabletop test cadence).
  4) Initiate the vendor security questionnaire you shared (please confirm preferred format).

Would you prefer initial evidence as PDFs via secure Share, or a secure SFTP link for larger artifacts? Also gimme a target by when you’d like the questionnaire completed — our preliminary plan is to return most items in 3–5 business days depending on level of granularity.

I’ve cc’d Marcus (Security) and Monica (Customer Success) who will lead the evidence and questionnaire responses.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: James Harris <james.harris@fintechcorp.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Security Team <security@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side and a small request: 

1) SOC 2: we require a SOC 2 Type II report for vendor risk when available. If you’re in the process, a current SOC 2 summary / bridge letter and an expected completion date is fine for now.

2) Breach notification: please confirm your external notification SLA (our security policy asks vendors to notify us within 72 hours of confirmed data exposure; confirm whether that aligns with Redwood’s commitment and any exceptions).

3) Incident response evidence: we’d like your incident response playbook (redacted for internal details if needed) and a short description of the IR escalation path and POCs.

4) BCP/DR: top-level slides or evidence of DR region, RTO/RPO, and most recent tabletop/exercise dates.

I’ve attached our vendor security questionnaire for reference (FintechCorp_Vendor_SecQ_20260305.xlsx). Could you return that completed within 5 business days? If you need more time for detailed controls evidence, please flag which items will take longer.

Preferred delivery: secure Share or encrypted email is fine. If you need an SFTP endpoint, let us know and we’ll provision.

Also looping in Legal (legal@fintechcorp.com) for any regulatory/contract questions.

Thanks,
James Harris
Head of Vendor Security, FintechCorp
security@fintechcorp.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: James Harris <james.harris@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Hi James — thanks, and good questions. I’m happy to take point from Redwood Security on the evidence and timing. Quick answers below and attached artifacts we can share immediately: 

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II for our platform in 2025 and are initiating the 2026 cycle. I’ll attach a short summary (redwood_SOC2_report_summary.pdf) and we can provide the full Type II report under an NDA / DPA once the 2026 report is finalized. Expected delivery for the next full Type II is Q2 2026.

- Breach notification SLA: Redwood’s standard commitment is to notify customers and impacted parties within 72 hours of confirming a data exposure incident that affects customer data, consistent with GDPR best practices. For incidents subject to other regulatory regimes (HIPAA/state breach laws), we will follow applicable timelines and will coordinate with the customer’s legal/compliance teams.

- Incident response: attaching incident_response_playbook_v2.pdf (redacted for public distribution) which outlines detection, containment, eradication, recovery steps, and communication timeline. Our escalation path: on-call engineer -> security on-call -> Head of Security (me) -> CTO / Legal as needed. Primary POC: security@redwood.com; for critical escalations: marcus.lin@redwood.com.

- BCP/DR: attaching bcp_overview_slide_deck.pdf with RTO/RPO targets and our DR region configuration. We run regular tabletop exercises (last tabletop: 2025-11-12; next scheduled: 2026-06).

Delivery method: We can provide these artifacts via a secure share link (preferred) or SFTP if you need. For the questionnaire: Monica will coordinate completion; please call out any items you consider showstoppers.

If you need a legal-ready statement or to sign an NDA prior to the full report, let me know and we’ll move that quickly.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: James Harris <james.harris@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Legal Team <legal@fintechcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Marcus / Neha — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple follow-ups and asks: 

- Can you confirm the exact notification workflow and timing for customers vs. regulators? For example, if an incident impacting customer data is discovered on day 0 and confirmed on day 2, do you commit to notify us on day 2 (within 72 hours of confirmation) or day 3? We need the explicit SLA wording for our vendor risk team.

- For HIPAA-scoped data: do you have BAAs in place with customers that require them? If so, are there any platform limitations we should be aware of?

- Data residency / dedicated DR region: we need confirmation whether FintechCorp workloads can be hosted in a dedicated DR region (us-east-1) and whether backups are geo-replicated.

- Please also provide the name/email of the legal contact who will handle any escalation.

We’ve attached the Vendor Security Questionnaire (FintechCorp_Vendor_SecQ_20260305.xlsx) — if you can return a first-pass within 5 business days that would be great. If you can’t complete everything in that window, please indicate which controls require more time.

We’re also open to a 30-minute follow-up call next Wednesday (2026-03-11) to walk through any open items — do you have availability?

Thanks,
James

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: James Harris <james.harris@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FintechCorp — Security & Incident Response follow-up

Hi James — thanks, will do. 

Quick commitments from our side: 
- We’ll return a completed first-pass of the questionnaire within 3 business days (by end of day 2026-03-10) with any items flagged for follow-up.
- Initial evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary, IR playbook excerpt, BCP deck) will be shared via a secure share link by EOD 2026-03-09. For the full SOC 2 Type II report we can provide under NDA/DPA when needed.
- Notification SLA language we can commit to: "Redwood will notify the customer within 72 hours of confirmation of a security incident that results in confirmed unauthorized access to customer data; Redwood will notify regulators as required by applicable law and will coordinate with customer legal/compliance for regulator-facing communications." If you want this as a one-paragraph legal-ready statement, I can coordinate with our Legal team and Marcus to provide.

On the HIPAA / BAA question — we do support HIPAA workflows and can sign a BAA where applicable; I’ll loop Legal if you need a draft.

For dedicated DR region and backups: we support region-specific deployment and geo-replicated backups; I’ll include RTO/RPO specifics in the BCP deck.

I’ll schedule a 30-minute call for Wed 2026-03-11 10:00 AM PT — invite to follow unless you propose a different time.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0189
